entity.name: Asset
entity.query: exec dbo.GetAllSolrNew

entity.name: AccessType
entity.query: select Name from AccessType where Id='${Asset.AccessTypeId}'

entity.name: Page
entity.query: select IsAlert,IsPrivate,WasPublished,PublicationUser,PublicationDate,ViewsCount,VotesCount,CommentsCount,ShareCount,Url,ShortUrl from Page where Id='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: News
entity.query: select * from News where Id='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: RelatedNewsEntity
entity.query: select RelatedAssetId from AssetAsset where AssetId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: AssetNode
entity.query: select NodeId from AssetNode where AssetId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: Node_en
entity.query: select Title from NodeContent where NodeId='${AssetNode.NodeId}' AND LanguageId='1'

entity.name: Node_es
entity.query: select Title from NodeContent where NodeId='${AssetNode.NodeId}' AND LanguageId='2'

entity.name: Node_slug
entity.query: select Description from Node where Id='${AssetNode.NodeId}'

entity.name: Node_Microsite
entity.query: select Id from Node where Id='${AssetNode.NodeId}' AND IsEnabled='1'

entity.name: AssetContent_en
entity.query: select Id,Title,Description,Volanta,SocialNetworkTitle from AssetContent where AssetId='${Asset.Id}' AND LanguageId='1'

entity.name: PageContent
entity.query: select * from PageContent where Id='${AssetContent_en.Id}'

entity.name: AssetContent_es
entity.query: select Id,Title,Description,Volanta,SocialNetworkTitle from AssetContent where AssetId='${Asset.Id}' AND LanguageId='2'

entity.name: PageContent
entity.query: select * from PageContent where Id='${AssetContent_es.Id}'

entity.name: Template
entity.query: select tp.Id, tp.Name, tp.Class from AssetContent ac INNER JOIN Template tp on ac.TemplateId = tp.Id where AssetId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: AssetMedia
entity.query: select MediaId from AssetMedia where AssetId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: Media
entity.query: select top 1 SizesPaths,Discriminator,Description,MediaUrl from Media where Id='${AssetMedia.MediaId}'

entity.name: PrintEdition
entity.query: select(select * from PrintEditionNew where NewId='${Asset.Id}' FOR JSON AUTO)AS Result

entity.name: PrintEditionId
entity.query: select PrintEditionId from PrintEditionNew where NewId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: AssetJson
entity.query: select (select [Json] as AssetJson FROM AssetJson where AssetId='${Asset.Id}' FOR JSON PATH) as Result

entity.name: AssetGallery
entity.query: select GalleryId from AssetGallery where AssetId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: Gallery
entity.query: SELECT * FROM Gallery where Id = '${AssetGallery.GalleryId}'

entity.name: MediaGallery
entity.query: select MediaId from MediaGallery where GalleryId='${Gallery.Id}' Order By [Order]

entity.name: GalleryMedia
entity.query: select Id,SizesPaths,ISNULL(MediaUrl, '') MediaUrl,Description from Media where Id='${MediaGallery.MediaId}'

entity.name: AssetAuthor
entity.query: select AuthorId from NewsAuthor where NewsId='${Asset.Id}'

entity.name: Author
entity.query: select FirstName+ ' ' + LastName as Name, MediaId, Id from Author where Id='${AssetAuthor.AuthorId}'

entity.name: Media
entity.query: select SizesPaths from Media where Id='${Author.MediaId}'
